Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) using BCL-xL as the bait. Acquisition is DDA based on the use of Q Exactive HF and MaxQuant LFQ workflow. PTMs (acetylated residue, iodoacetamide) are listed in PRIDE metadata identifiedPTMStrings, likely as standard variable modifications during search.

scope: immunoprecipitation of BCL-xL coupled with mass spectrometry analysis identified that BCL-xL forms unique molecular complexes
BCL-xL from uRBCs and iRBCs was immunoprecipitated (IP) using a human anti-BCL-xL antibody, and mass spectrometry was used to analyse the immunoprecipitated proteins (IP).
The BCL-xL immunoprecipitated samples (i.e., BCL-xL-coated magnetic beads and bound proteins) were resolved on a 1D PAGE gel
Affinity purification coupled with mass spectrometry proteomics

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically used immunoprecipitation of BCL-xL followed by MS to compare binding partners in uninfected vs infected RBCs, and the effect of the inhibitor WEHI-539 on those complexes. While six inhibitors were used for growth assays, only WEHI-539 was used for the MS-analyzed samples.
